lines.1: That night, I came home completely exhausted.
lines.2: 「I saw Konoe dragging you all over the place today.」
lines.3: 「We kinda stood out... We were in costume and all.」
lines.4: 「Looks like you're being a real help to her. Good job.」
lines.5: Otome came closer, reaching out to pat my head.
lines.6: 「I don't know if I'm actually helping.」
lines.8: 「I mean, I spend the whole time getting yelled at.」
lines.11: 「Leo's doing very well. Good boy, good boy.」
lines.17: 「Leave it to me. I'll make rice balls packed with meat.」
lines.18: Getting praised by Otome put some life back into me.
lines.20: All right. I've got another day tomorrow, so time to sleep and recharge.
lines.22: Subaru climbed in through the window.
lines.23: 「What is it, Subaru? I was planning to sleep tonight.」
lines.24: 「Just hear me out. Track club was working late too.」
lines.25: 「On the way home, I saw Konoe doing something at the school gate.」
lines.27: 「She was doing it alone. That okay?」
lines.28: 「She's the one who said she'd do it alone.」
lines.29: 「Besides, it's already this late. She's probably gone home by now.」
lines.30: 「Well, if you're fine with it, whatever. Later.」
lines.31: Subaru vanished almost as quickly as he'd appeared.
lines.33: Still, the fact that she really was doing it all by herself...
lines.34: She really didn't have much pull with people, did she...
lines.35: Though given the way she charged ahead, I guess that was inevitable.
lines.38: Surely Konoe had gone home by now.
lines.40: When she said she'd work hard, just how hard did she mean?
lines.42: 「She's the one who said she'd do it alone.」
lines.44: 「Agh, damn it! Now I can't stop thinking about it!」
lines.46: 「Leo. How about a game of hanafuda with your big sis for once?」
lines.49: 「It's about Konoe. Just a quick thing.」
lines.50: 「Mm. If you invoke that name, I can't exactly object when I'm the one who asked you to help her.」
